players.product: PLC optical splitters and AWG devices; PIN/APD photodiode chips and ROSA modules (10G-100G) for data centre and 5G

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 29,252,810,941 and operating profit KRW 4,021,112,793; Q2 2026 revenue KRW 14,727,621,026, operating profit KRW 2,554,875,343. Optical communications segment revenue KRW 8,736,009 thousand (KRW 5,173,011 thousand in H1 2025) with segment operating profit KRW 1,325,384 thousand (loss of KRW 1,663,457 thousand a year earlier); photodiodes KRW 6,668 million (22.8%), PLC splitters KRW 2,027 million (6.9%); the SI segment (Western Digital storage distribution) was 59.2% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue KRW 29,252,810,941; optical segment KRW 8,736,009 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 utilisation - photodiode chips 100.4% (95.6% in 2025), photodiode modules 43.2%, PLC splitter wafers 71.4%.

Half-year report: supplies 10G, 25G, 50G and 100G photodiodes for data centre and 5G; working on technology development and early mass production of 400G and 800G products; AWG devices are used in data centre and 5G WDM links; 50Gbaud InGaAs APD chip and APD-ROSA module government project runs 2023-07-17 to 2027-07-16.

Company outlook (half-year report): in China, continued 5G investment is expected to expand sales of high-spec 25G ROSA and 100G ROSA; domestically, photodiode supply to transceiver makers is expected to keep growing with 5G expansion; pursuing large customers in the US and Europe.
Half-year report customer concentration: one customer over 10% of consolidated revenue - customer A KRW 2,998,170 thousand (10.3%) in H1 2026.

Wooriro.why: Korean maker of photodiode chips / ROSA modules and PLC splitter / AWG devices used in optical transceivers for data centre and 5G; supplies receiver components to transceiver makers (e.g. Lightron).
Wooriro.evidence: Wooriro Q2 FY2026 (08-12-2026): supplies 10G-100G photodiodes for data centre and 5G, developing 400G/800G products; photodiode chip utilisation 100.4%.
